panels.title: Recompress after aggregation
panels.subtitle: CIFAR-100 · ResNet-20 · 20 clients · 20 rounds · reduction relative to FedAvg
panels.finding: Server recompression lifts communication reduction from 1.02× to 3.80×; CIFAR-100 accuracy loss is 1.88 pp.

panels.title: Savings across five tasks
panels.subtitle: 20 clients · 20 rounds · accuracy mean of 2 trials
panels.finding: 3.80–5.41× less communication accompanies 0.31–1.88 pp accuracy loss; audio tasks have the smallest losses.

takeaways: Server recompression matters: client clustering alone leaves little bidirectional saving in the CIFAR-100 ablation.
The savings require 10 extra server epochs per round and auxiliary unlabeled data.
